nodes.name: Theorem 1.2: tabular @ c@ NTK approximation error bound tabular
nodes.statement:
Let $R(y) = \frac{1}{2} \|y - y^*\|^2$ be the square loss. Assume that $Dh$ is $\mathrm{Lip}(Dh)$-Lipschitz in a ball of radius $\rho$ around ${\boldsymbol w}_0$. Then, at any time $0 \leq T \leq \alpha^2 \rho^2 / R_0$,
\begin{align}\|\alpha h({\boldsymbol w}(T)) - \alpha \bar h(\bar {\boldsymbol w}(T))\| \leq \min(6 \kappa \sqrt{R_0} , \sqrt{8R_0})\,.\end{align}

nodes.name: Lemma A.10: tabular @ c@ Bound on derivative of interpolation between product integrals tabular
nodes.statement: For all $\zeta \in [0,1]$, we have the bound $$\|\frac{\partial P(T,0;\zeta)}{\partial \zeta}\| \leq (\sup_{t \in [0,T]} \|C_t\|) (2\sqrt{T} + 3 T \cdot {\mathcal V}(\{C_t\}_{t \in [0,T]}))\,.$$
